name: Камень — добытый ресурс
subject: ONE small raw stone fragment ONLY, low broad coarse warm-gray chunk approximately five voxel units wide and three units high, asymmetrical stepped broken upper corner, one pale chip on one side. Small pickup piece, not a large boulder or a connected deposit. Front/back broad faces, left/right opposing narrow profiles, same chipped corner locations after rotation, isometric shows full shape. No extra piece, vein, glow, pile or ground.
caption: Пять ракурсов одной части добытого ресурса. В игре используются 1–3 экземпляра; количество и масштаб задаёт существующая система подбора.
